name: insomnikit
description: Minimal macOS menu bar utility that prevents sleep, with timer and battery-aware auto-disable.
author: racgoo

scripts.start: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.pack: rm -rf dist release && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.js && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist: rm -rf dist release && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.js && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:dir: rm -rf dist release && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-renderer.js && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --dir
